page.overview:
Who is Baker?

Clone Captain Baker was a clone commando who served in the Galactic Republic and subsequently the Galactic Empire that replaced it following the Clone Wars. Eventually, Baker served as an instructor of TK stormtroopers on Umbara before defecting to the Clone Underground led by Clone Commander Rex.

Baker appeared in the video game Star Wars Zero Company, which released on August 27, 2026.
